title: Sony BURANO 8.6K Full-Frame CineAlta Digital Cinema Camera
purpose: Flagship 8.6K full-frame single-operator CineAlta motion picture camera uniting Dual PL/E-mount lens support, world-first in-body optical image stabilization for PL cinema lenses, built-in Electronic Variable ND, 16 stops dynamic range, and internal 16-bit X-OCN LT.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.9 x 24.0mm Full-Frame 8.6K CineAlta CMOS sensor (8632 x 4856 16:9 / 35.9x20.2mm active, 16-bit internal X-OCN LT RAW)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm large-area full-frame cinema field of view (native PL & E-mount)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Cooke S7/i Full Frame Plus 50mm T2.0 Cine Prime (or ARRI Signature Prime 47mm T1.8 with in-body PL IBIS)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Dual Base ISO 800 / 3200 (S-Gamut3.Cine / S-Log3) with built-in Electronic Variable ND (0.6–2.1)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16 stops benchmark CineAlta dynamic range in 16-bit X-OCN LT RAW with smooth highlight roll-off
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 180-degree cinema shutter angle (1/48s motion cadence) stabilized via 5-axis PL/E-mount IBIS

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Feature film production soft key lighting through muslin/diffusion with deep sculpted negative fill across 16 stops of latitude
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Flagship 8.6K CineAlta light transport delivering painterly highlight roll-off, rich shadow micro-contrast, and natural organic skin colorimetry

surface_rendering: 8.6K 16-bit X-OCN optical acuity resolving fine eyelashes, skin micro-relief, and period costume fabric with theatrical softness
Smooth 16-stop tonal ramp keeping bright practicals and sunlit exteriors completely unclipped
Zero digital sharpening edge halos or compressed video chroma artifacts
depth_and_optics: Full-frame PL cinema prime rendering with sculpted focal transition, circular bokeh, and gentle corner vignette
Stabilized handheld PL-mount organic movement eliminating micro-jitter
True rectified theatrical cinema projection geometry

execution_directive: Enforce Sony BURANO 8.6K full-frame CineAlta digital cinema aesthetics with PL-mount cinema prime character, Dual Base ISO 800/3200, 16 stops dynamic range in 16-bit X-OCN LT, and organic S-Gamut3.Cine highlight roll-off.
